latest_release.name: RTorrent 0.16.28
latest_release.body:
## Summary

This release contains a few minor bug fixes and cleanup, and is part of a stable release series.

Includes DHT IPv6 Support and minor performance optimizations.


### Development Funding

Current development relies on donations, and as such is highly appreciated.


## Donations make futher development possible, and as such are highly appreciated:

 * [Paypal](https://paypal.me/jarisundellno)
 * [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/rtorrent)
 * [SubscribeStar](https://www.subscribestar.com/rtorrent)
 * Bitcoin: 1MpmXm5AHtdBoDaLZstJw8nupJJaeKu8V8
 * Ethereum: 0x9AB1e3C3d8a875e870f161b3e9287Db0E6DAfF78
 * Litecoin: LdyaVR67LBnTf6mAT4QJnjSG2Zk67qxmfQ
 * Cardano: addr1qytaslmqmk6dspltw06sp0zf83dh09u79j49ceh5y26zdcccgq4ph7nmx6kgmzeldauj43254ey97f3x4xw49d86aguqwfhlte



## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes / Cleanup / Improvements

* Add IPv6 DHT support (BEP 32) by @silasmariusz
* dht: use get_peers during announce walk and increase announce fanout by @silasmariusz
* Open the datagram listen socket only when checking the DHT port by @IvanShift
* Install linked_unordered_set.h and add iterators, find, back, pop_back and erase to it by @IvanShift
* Added back missing check in DownloadWrapper::receive_update_priorities(). by @rakshasa
* Moved DownloadWrapper::receive_update_priorities() check for chunk selector state by @rakshasa
* Keep user-added trackers flagged as extra when loading them from resume data by @IvanShift
* Fix rtorrent randomly crashes with inet6 peers by @rosset
* Remember a stop request that arrives while the thread is not polling by @IvanShift
* Replace sorted_vector with limited_vector by @rakshasa
* Fixed utils::copy_limited() handling of non-empty containers. by @rakshasa
* Optimized rebalancing of linux_unordered_set. by @rakshasa
* Allow AF_INET6 in set_generic_address_unsafe (fix #951) by @rosset
* Rotate a torrent's download slots when all are held, and keep a peer whose slot was taken back by @silasmariusz
* Group peer connection up/down members into state structs by @rakshasa
* Move ProtocolRead/Write into m_up/m_down state structs by @rakshasa
* Fix download slot rotation tests after state refactor by @rakshasa
* Sync with CONFIG-Template by @MarkusLange
* Modify logging levels and groups in rtorrent.rc.lua-example by @MarkusLange
* Do not assume libstdc++ in TestView::test_multicall_skips_moved_entries by @IvanShift
* Stop running commands on a download that an earlier command erased by @IvanShift
* Do not loop forever on a comment in parse_command_multiple by @IvanShift
* Do not touch a download an event handler erased in the command_events.cc loops by @IvanShift
* Build the unit test variants with --enable-extra-debug too by @IvanShift
* Keep DownloadList in a linked_unordered_set keyed by info hash by @IvanShift
* Do not start a session save while another save of the download runs by @IvanShift
* Show why a download failed to resume and release its active slot by @IvanShift
